parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The filter condition that is used to query instances. If you do not configure this parameter, all instances are queried.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Valid values: 1 to 100000000.

If you set this parameter to a value smaller than 1, the system uses 1 as the value. If you set this parameter to a value greater than 100000000, the system uses 100000000 as the value.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Value values: 10 to 200.

If you set this parameter to a value smaller than 10, the system uses 10 as the value. If you set this parameter to a value greater than 200, the system uses 200 as the value.

parameters.name: resourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: seriesCodes
parameters.description:
The primary edition of the instance.

Valid values:

*   standard: Standard Edition
*   ultimate: Enterprise Platinum Edition
*   professional: Professional Edition

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: The tags that are used to filter instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rocketmq list-instances --filter rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfmx7caj000000 --tags key_:_rmq-test_,_value_:_test --series-codes standard --storage-secret-key xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rocketmq GET /instances --region cn-hangzhou --filter 'rmq-cn-7e22ody0000' --pageNumber 1 --storageSecretKey xxxxx --pageSize 10 --resourceGroupId 'rg-acfmx7caj000000' --seriesCodes standard --tags 'key_:_rmq-test_,_value_:_test' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
